pages.quiz:
GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   B. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   D. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

3. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   C. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   B. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   D. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   B. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   C. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.

6. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

7. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

8. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

9. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   B. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.

11. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   D. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Rocks and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Folding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

2. C — Explain symbols used on a map

3. D — Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. C — Nairobi

10. B — Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. B — Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Earthquakes; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
